global_notes: All dimensions are nominal assembled coordinates in millimetres.
Dimensions are inspection overlays that may show through the shell; no inference of visibility or physical qualification.
Battery lower1 mm is padding allowance, not added free clearance.
The 0.50 mm OLED value is a vertical datum-plane offset, not minimum distance to surrounding lid material.
PCB surface dimensions refer to the assigned C5 carrier top mask, excluding components; the separate nominal design datum Z8.000 remains metadata only.
Exploded view dimensions must be hidden to avoid interpreting presentation offsets as assembled gaps.
